messages:
Samir Rao: Kicking off org onboarding for Project Orion. Need cross-cloud quota + network limits signoff (AWS/GCP/Azure). Primary ask: ability to run 8x A100 or 16x T4 equivalent per region initially, 2 TB persistent storage per account, and egress cap considerations. Who's grabbing quotas?
Maria Chen: I can own GCP and Azure quota requests. Will submit today. Quick Q: do we prefer H100s in us-west1 or stick to A100 for predictability? :thinking_face: 
Dinesh Patel: For latency-sensitive batches H100 is nicer but availability is flaky in some zones. Proposal: request A100 baseline + optional H100 request (soft quota) in us-west1 and eu-west1.
Jess Rivera: I'll do IAM + tagging + billing setup. Need exact tag schema from product (cost center + project + env). Can we standardize now?
Samir Rao: Yes — tags: redwood.cost_center, redwood.project, redwood.env, redwood.owner. env values: prod/stage/dev. Share in a PR please.
Kevin Liu: Heads up: Azure enforces vCPU and regional GPU quotas separately — include vCPU bump in request. Also note networking: default egress limit alert thresholds apply — request 5 TB/month soft cap for first quarter.
Maria Chen: Drafting GCP quota request. Using this template to GCP support:```Project: redwood-orion-prod
Regions: us-west1, europe-west1
GPUs: A100 (count): 8 per region
Accelerator type fallback: T4 (count): 16 per region
vCPUs: +200 per region
Persistent disk: SSD 2TB per project
Network egress: 5TB/mo soft cap
Justification: Production inference fleet for Orion, latency-sensitive, will run canary traffic first 2 weeks.```
Samir Rao: Perfect. Add note to request expedited review (SRE oncall will monitor).
Dinesh Patel: Azure request snippet (ARM support form): "subscriptionId: xxxxx, quota: Standard_ND96asr_v4: 8 per region; vCPUs: +220; network: 5000 GB/mo soft alert". I'll attach perf profile.
Jess Rivera: IAM plan: create service accounts per environment: `svc-orion-prod-infer`, `svc-orion-stage-infer`. Roles: compute.admin (scoped), storage.objectAdmin (restricted bucket), and custom role `inference-deployer` for rollout-only access. Also enable org policy to enforce tags on resource creation.
Kevin Liu: Networking checklist: VPC per cloud + shared services VPC. Need VPC peering or VPN between clouds? Recommendation: start with no cross-cloud peering; keep traffic between clouds via public endpoints behind mTLS for now to avoid latency of mesh. Add egress cost estimate spreadsheet link: https://short.link/redwood-orion-egress-estimates
Samir Rao: Good conservative approach. We'll revisit peering after we hit 50% of egress.
Maria Chen: Submitting GCP ticket now. Support case #GP-90231. ETA for review: 48-72 hrs with expedited flag. Copying Cc: `infra-oncall` and `platform-ops`.
infra-bot: Deployment window scheduled: canary start 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC — add change request once quotas approved.
Billing Bot: FYI — estimated monthly incremental cost (A100 baseline) ~ $28k across three regions. See cost model doc: https://short.link/redwood-orion-costs. Approvals needed from Finance for committed capacity above $20k/mo.
Samir Rao: @Billing Bot thanks — I'll loop in Finance after quota confirmation. Maria, Dinesh — please paste support ticket IDs here when created. Jess — open PR for tags + IAM.
Maria Chen: GCP ticket created: GP-90231 (submitted). Included sample usage and canary dates.
Dinesh Patel: Azure support case: AZ-77422 created. Attached throughput profile and canary plan.
Jess Rivera: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/org-policies/pull/614 — includes tags, IAM roles, org policy. Requesting reviews from @Samir and @Kevin.
Samir Rao: Thanks team. We'll check back in tomorrow 10:30am PT for status and next steps. :thumbsup:
